summary: Retail Technology Group (RTG), founded in 2003 and headquartered in the St. Louis, MO area, provides end-to-end POS deployment, staging, logistics, installation, and lifecycle support services to more than 35,000 multi-location retail, restaurant, hospitality, and convenience-store establishments, with 200+ employees and a network of 1,000+ field technicians.

RTG was acquired by French POS/kiosk manufacturer AURES Technologies at the end of 2018, when RTG had approximately $40 million in annual revenue and 350+ employees; AURES itself was subsequently acquired by Taiwan-based Advantech, finalized in 2024, placing RTG under the Advantech-AURES brand.
